description: Replace this scene’s added sound cues; an empty cues list removes them. Use names from scenes.soundOptions and word indices from soundWords. Preserve speech; the global sound mute still applies. Read get_project_context first. Saves a new version at once (restore_version undoes it); a change it cannot make is refused and nothing changes. Uses the direct-edit allowance. Cost: Free: no credits.

base_version.description: From get_project_context; the live version when left out.

cues.description: The scene’s new cues, up to 8 (an empty list removes them): name from scenes.soundOptions, on a word number from soundWords.

operation_id.description: The same id on a retry runs it once; a new id is a new request.

output_id.description: A hook, Short or shape from check_video; the main video when left out.

name: set_scene_sounds

outputSchema.description: Clypmint set_scene_sounds result. Error results carry error; successful requests expose the identifiers and state available for the next step. Signed media stays in private metadata.

title: Change scene sound cues
